headline: Immediate reaction: Northgate equalises via quick set-piece sequence and wide transition
explanation: After Riverside's goal at 25:40 (event 280), Northgate restarted play through a corner (event 277) and then progressed into the final third with Osei's forward pass (event 278). Fitzgerald carried the ball into a wide attacking position with a successful dribble (event 281), allowing Nakamura to finish from the right-hand side 10 seconds later (event 282).
tactical_pattern: Quick set-piece restart into a forward third pass, then immediate exploitation of the wide channel with a carrying dribble that isolates space for the right-sided finisher.
